term: moves itself in the same respect (movens et motum secundum idem)
definition: A thing moves itself in the same respect when it is the mover of itself in the very respect in which it is moved: `MovesIn x x r`. The prima via denies this of whatever is moved (ST I q.2 a.3 co.: impossibile est … quod, secundum idem et eodem modo, aliquid sit movens et motum, vel quod moveat seipsum).
